Common questions

Why check before I call?

Ghost posts, missing dimensions, and “rate TBD” waste drive time and family time. A two-minute checklist filters junk so you only dial loads that can actually work for your truck.

Do my checks get uploaded?

No. Checklist state stays in your browser (local storage on this device only). Nothing is sent to our servers when you tick boxes.

What should I confirm on the phone?

Pickup window, weight, dimensions, loading help, site conditions, and all-in rate — then a rate confirmation in writing before you deadhead. The script on this page is a starting template.

Is this checklist free?

Yes — no signup. Pair it with the free rate calculator and DOT verification guide before you roll.
